question: Estimate the number of two-wheelers on Indian roads.
idealClarificationQuestions: Cumulative on-road stock (registered + active)? Active operational only.
Includes scooters + motorcycles + mopeds? Yes — all 2W.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: From cumulative sales × average vehicle life × scrappage.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Annual 2W sales in India: ~17-20M units (recovered post-COVID).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Cumulative stock = sum of last 12 years sales × survival rate.
